question: Where was the 19th India Digital Summit (IDS) 2025 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **19th edition** of the **India Digital Summit (IDS) 2025** was held in **New Delhi**.
 
• The event took place on **February 5 and 6, 2025**, at the prestigious **Bharat Mandapam**, located at **Pragati Maidan**.
 
• It was organized by the **Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI)**, which is the premier industry body representing the digital services sector in the country.
 
• The theme for the **2025** summit was **"India's Techade: Scaling Innovations for the World"**, emphasizing India's growing role as a global hub for technological advancements.
 
• The summit featured over **500 speakers** and saw participation from more than **10,000 delegates**, including policymakers, tech founders, and industry leaders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI):**

 
 
• Established in **2004**, it is a **non-profit organization** registered under the **Societies Registration Act, 1860**.
 
• It represents the interests of the online and mobile value-added services industry, including **E-commerce, Fintech, Digital Advertising, and EdTech** sectors.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Mandapam:**
 
 
• This state-of-the-art **International Exhibition-cum-Convention Centre (IECC)** complex in **New Delhi** was the venue for the **G20 Summit** in **2023**.
 
• It is one of the largest convention centers in the world, designed to host high-level international exhibitions and trade fairs.
 
 
 
• **India's Digital Growth:**
 
 
• The **India Digital Summit** is one of the oldest and most influential digital industry events in India, tracking the nation's journey from early internet adoption to becoming a **digital powerhouse**.
 
• Recent summits have focused on critical areas such as **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, the **Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC)**, and the expansion of the **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)** ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Focus on Startups:**
 
 
• The **IDS 2025** serves as a platform for **startups** to engage with venture capitalists and government officials to foster the **NextGen** of Indian entrepreneurship.
